name: Terrassen-Camping am Richterbichl
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Terrassen-Camping am Richterbichl is located in Rottenbuch and offers pitches on terraced areas with a view of the surrounding mountain landscape. The location in the Ammergauer Alpen makes the site an ideal starting point for hikes, bike tours, and excursions into nature. Nearby, you'll find ski resorts and cross-country ski trails that can be used during the winter months. The campsite features sanitary facilities, power connections, and basic amenities for campers. Guests will find pitches for motorhomes and caravans, as well as areas for tents. The surroundings are characterized by meadows, forests, and typical alpine nature, inviting you to take extended walks. Various of different difficulty levels start directly near the site. The peaceful atmosphere of the site is geared towards those seeking relaxation who appreciate alpine nature.
